card.name: Commas before dehydration-risk conditions
card.fires_on: Commas in lists of kidney-risk conditions, right before dehydration, hypovolemia or heart failure is named. Also "to" in "unable to sense or respond to thirst".

modes.label: List comma
modes.description: A comma after renal or hepatic impairment in a list of patients at risk for kidney problems.
modes.example: Monitor renal function in patients with renal or hepatic impairment<<,>> heart failure, dehydration, or hypov

modes.label: Before thirst
modes.description: The word "to" just before thirst in a contraindication.
modes.example: Unable to sense or respond<< to>> thirst Hypovolemic hyponat

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about dehydration, thirst, moisture and hydration.
card.plain: It fires where a list of kidney-risk conditions is about to name dehydration or fluid loss.
